args.message: Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, which contradicted its own docstring and caused nightly test failures (`tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding per FIN-212).

## Change
Switch the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so ties round to the nearest even cent:
- `Decimal("2.675")` -> `2.68`
- `Decimal("2.665")` -> `2.66`

## Testing
CI run `ci-0001` on `08d3cd5986` passed.
